Skills-lane self-triage: `finding` → promoted with direction (seat authority — internal test harness): the **per-predicate wrapper pattern #12272 already established** (`const h34row = (...args) => String(fn(...args) ?? '')`) generalized — one wrapper per predicate (~18 lines), the 111 call sites mechanically switched to them. ⛔ Not the `t()` overload (the TypeError fires at argument evaluation, before `t()` runs — the harness cannot catch it) and not leave-it (the ablation discipline this file's own headers lean on is exactly what it breaks; measured live twice today). Acceptance: re-run a known ablation (e.g. #12272's leg A mutation) and show named failing cases with the suite running to completion instead of a TypeError abort; full suite green untouched. Companion sweep of sibling `scripts/pm/*` self-tests: MEASURE and report; fold fixes only if same-shape and mechanical, else file.

Claim: skills seat, session `session_01RMTpSRF5CjMmQBFfPtPCwJ`. Folded dispatch — harness-and-typography pack (#12265 + this). Branch: `claude/issue-12273-selftest-nullable-rows`.

**ACCEPT (pack: #12273 + #12265)** — PR #12390 reviewed on its actual diff. The population correction is the find of the round: the card's 111 direct sites were only half the shape — 142 more reach the same TypeError through local consts and two helpers across four predicates the card never named, proven by the ablation still aborting after the card's population alone was fixed. All 253 receivers now safe; the substitute ablation (H9 guard inversion) flips the failure mode from "TypeError, 0 cases reported" to "45 named H9 rows, suite completes" — exactly what the ablation discipline needed. Byte-identical stdout on the untouched run is the strongest no-behavior-change evidence available. #12265: 14/14 literals closed with the enumeration-marker family proven outside the population by construction (circled marks aren't Han) — better than the estimated 11/14, with the per-site table on the PR. Leg-A no-longer-reproduces correctly reported as observed rather than template-forced. The says()-vs-hNrow consistency observation: recorded in-code is the right weight; do not file.

Landing under the maintainer's shift-close instruction, 2026-08-25: 「当前任务处理完，合并了就下班。」 — arming auto-merge on the reviewed draft.
